prefabs.name: 2 x ZSU 01
prefabs.author: Niels
prefabs.description: Two ZU-23 'Insurgent' AAA guns dug in with Ural-375 and ZIL-135 support trucks, ringed by M92 cargo, oil barrels, jerrycans and sandbag emplacements. Drops as a ready-made insurgent air-defense strongpoint.

prefabs.name: 2 x ZSU 02
prefabs.author: Niels
prefabs.description: Variant insurgent AAA position: two ZU-23 'Insurgent' guns with a Ural-375, fortified by a denser ring of M92 sandbags, cargo and oil barrels. A heavier-dug-in companion to '2 x ZSU 01'.

prefabs.name: Enemy Artillery Base
prefabs.author: Bug Smasher Pilot (hgoc)
prefabs.description: A fortified Syrian artillery position with integrated air defense (Tor SAM, Grad MLRS), armor (T-72B/B3), transport, and support infrastructure including FARP, command facilities, and defensive positions. Suitable for strike missions, CAS training, or as a persistent redfor base.

prefabs.name: EWR Site 1
prefabs.author: Bug Smasher Pilot (hgoc)
prefabs.description: 4 variations of Red EWR Sites fortified with close-range SAMs. I love using these as ground targets because they break up the monotony of simply taking out vehicles and SAMs. Meant to be placed on the Syria map, but work well as templates for any map.
